title: How do I use Medipyxis? Video training, from referral to signed visit
body_excerpt: Sixteen short videos with spoken narration, on-screen captions and full transcripts walk through Medipyxis: navigation, HR, the referral CRM, fax referrals with OCR, patient intake, assignment and booking, visit documentation, orders and DME, IVR requests, the product catalog and inventory, Fleet Calendar, the Oversight Cockpit and Team Chat.

title: What's new, in video
body_excerpt: Short silent videos of recent changes in Medipyxis, including Indication on debridement pop-ups, Fax Review Queue search, Use last order and the chart MRN, today's wounds on an order, and chart MRN on a new order form.

title: How do I record the indication on a debridement pop-up?
body_excerpt: On sharp and enzymatic debridement pop-ups, Indication is now the first field. The silent video shows the Indication list, sharp choices Slough, Biofilm and Other with free text (Fibrinous wound bed), and enzymatic choices Necrotic / devitalized tissue and Eschar.

title: How do I search the Fax Review Queue?
body_excerpt: Search the Fax Review Queue by patient name or sender fax. With Search all fax text on, a phrase in the subject is found and marked Matched: Subject.

title: How does Use last order fill the MRN?
body_excerpt: Use last order copies the previous order into a new draft. If that order’s ID / MRN was empty, the new form fills the chart MRN.

title: How do I pick a wound from today's visit on an order?
body_excerpt: The order wound picker includes wounds from today’s unsigned visit, labelled (new from today’s visit). A chart wound fills its measured size; a new draft wound fills location.

title: How does a new order form get the chart MRN?
body_excerpt: A new Wound Care Supplies Order prefills ID / MRN from the chart. The field stays editable. The form is closed without saving.

title: How do I upload my practice's consent form?
body_excerpt: Practices can upload their own consent form as a PDF in Administrator Hub, Consent Documentation. Practices that have not uploaded a form see no change.

title: Deceased card and filter
body_excerpt: All Patients has a Deceased card. Clicking it lists deceased patients, and the status filter shows Deceased.
